instruction: Find the IndexError in get_last() when called on a list with items.
target_output: Bug at src/utils.py line 3: items[len(items)] should be items[len(items)-1]. Off-by-one error causes IndexError.
patch_diff:
--- a/src/utils.py
+++ b/src/utils.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def get_last(items):
     if not items:
         return None
-    return items[len(items)]
+    return items[len(items) - 1]
reasoning_trace: Off-by-one: list indices go from 0 to len-1, so the last element is at len(items)-1.

metadata.plan: 1. Read utils.py. 2. Notice items[len(items)] is out of bounds. 3. Fix to items[len(items)-1]. 4. Verify with test.
